homology_model.H1_Q: U=K^6 viewed as a 12-dimensional Q-vector space

cohomology_carrier.H1_cohomology_Q: V=Hom_Q(U,Q), with the contragredient K-action; V is again 6-dimensional over K and 12-dimensional over Q
cohomology_carrier.discriminant_note: Passing to the dual Hermitian space inverts det(h); [-1/3]=[-3] in Q^*/Nm(K^*) because their ratio 1/9 is Nm(1/3). Thus the discriminant component is unchanged in the quotient.

hermitian_form_on_homology.convention: K-linear in the first variable and conjugate-linear in the second

non_split_certificate.proof_ratio_not_norm: If 3=Nm(a+bi) with a,b in Q, clearing denominators gives coprime integers x,y,z with x^2+y^2=3z^2. Modulo 3, the only way x^2+y^2 is 0 is x=y=0 mod 3; then the equation forces z=0 mod 3, contradicting coprimality. Hence 3 is not a norm and [-3] != [-1].

polarization_model.integrality: For x,y in Z[i]^6, h(x,y) is in Z[i] and (1/2)Tr(i*h(x,y)) is an integer.
polarization_model.explicit_nonempty_period_point: Let I be multiplication by i on U_R. Define J0=+I on the first three K-coordinates and J0=-I on the last three. Then J0 commutes with K, preserves E, and E(x,J0 x)>0 for x!=0 because h is positive on the first three coordinates and negative on the last three.
polarization_model.period_domain: D_h is the connected component containing J0 of complex structures J on U_R commuting with K, preserving E, and satisfying E(x,Jx)>0. It is the U(3,3)/(U(3)xU(3)) Weil-type Hermitian domain.
polarization_model.family: A_J=(U_R,J)/Lambda for J in D_h; every member is a polarized complex abelian sixfold with the fixed K-action, Weil signature (3,3), and discriminant class [-3].

frontier_member.choice: A_gen=A_{J_gen} for a very general J_gen in D_h, chosen outside the countable union of proper rational Hodge loci and special solved/isogeny loci before any cycle search.
frontier_member.reason_for_genericity: The polarization class is always rational (1,1); every additional rational degree-two Hodge class imposes a proper Hodge-locus condition. The very-general point is chosen outside the countable union of such proper loci.
frontier_member.not_a_positive_control: The explicit J0 only proves nonemptiness of D_h and is not used as the frontier target; the target is the very-general fixed-discriminant member.

weil_hodge_space.definition: W_K(A_gen)=wedge_K^6 V, realized inside wedge_Q^6 V as the Q-descended subspace whose complexification is wedge^6 V_sigma direct-sum wedge^6 V_sigma_bar.
weil_hodge_space.dimension_proof: wedge_K^6 V is one-dimensional over K because dim_K V=6; since [K:Q]=2, its underlying rational dimension is 2. Equivalently, after complexification the determinant lines wedge^6 V_sigma and wedge^6 V_sigma_bar are one-dimensional and exchanged by conjugation.
weil_hodge_space.hodge_type_proof: For Weil signature (3,3), V_sigma has Hodge dimensions 3 in (1,0) and 3 in (0,1), and the same holds for V_sigma_bar. Hence wedge^6 V_sigma = wedge^3 V_sigma^(1,0) tensor wedge^3 V_sigma^(0,1), of Hodge type (3,3); likewise for the conjugate determinant line. Thus every rational class in W_K is of type (3,3).

divisor_algebra_separation.conclusion: These are distinct direct summands of wedge^6(V_sigma direct-sum V_sigma_bar), so W_K(A_gen) intersects the divisor-generated degree-six line trivially. The target exceptional Weil space is therefore not being replaced by divisor products.

scope_caveat: No algebraicity of W_K is asserted. This artifact fixes only an exact open-frontier polarized family and the rational cohomological Hodge carrier that any later cycle/obstruction mechanism must hit.
